data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":{"adopted_commitment_refs":[],"disanalogies":["A diagnostic test is a passive measurement of a fixed biological state, while a checklist is an active procedural intervention executed by agents who may reinterpret or supplement it.","Diagnostic-test validity is established by a gold standard external to the test, while checklist reliability is evaluated against the same outcome distribution the checklist is applied to.","Adversarial probes in diagnosis are biological contrivances; adversarial items in evaluation are constructed by the same process that defines 'genuine reliability,' risking circularity."],"overturn_conditions":["It is shown that adversarial items cannot be constructed without already knowing the causal structure the checklist is supposed to encode, making the test circular and invalidating its discriminating power.","It is shown that the expert also fails adversarial items, so panel survival reveals nothing about genuine reliability beyond shared difficulty.","It is shown that a checklist can achieve genuine reliability on the natural distribution without being causally complete, so adversarial decoupling is unnecessary for reliability in practice."],"shared_structure":["Both distinguish a deep structural test from a surface proxy that happens to correlate.","Both rely on probes designed to decouple the proxy from the target condition to expose the difference.","Both predict that a mere proxy breaks exactly when the decoupling probe is applied."],"source_memory_refs":["SRC_003"],"transfer_claims":["The adversarial-probe methodology transfers: just as a diagnostic test is validated by cases where surface symptoms mislead, a checklist is stress-tested by items where surface cues diverge from outcome-determining structure.","The diagnostic-test distinction between true positive and false positive transfers to the distinction between genuine structural reliability and mere compliance that happens to track the right answer.","If the checklist cannot survive adversarial decoupling probes, it is epistemically equivalent to a diagnostic test that fails on atypical presentations: reliable only on the easy distribution."]},"claim":"A single evaluation can distinguish genuine reliability gain from mere compliance if and only if it includes adversarial items where the checklist's surface cues decouple from the underlying causal structure; on such items, genuine reliability predicts sustained accuracy, while mere compliance predicts systematic failure.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The checklist is explicitly designed as a pure surface-correlational heuristic with no causal pretension, making the compliance-vs-genuine distinction moot by design.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The evaluated distribution does not include any items where surface cues and causal structure diverge, so no within-evaluation probe can separate the hypotheses.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The expert's intuition also fails on the adversarial items, eliminating the contrast needed to attribute the panel's performance to genuine reliability rather than shared difficulty.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The panel applies extra-checklist reasoning that restores accuracy on adversarial items, so the checklist's causal completeness is confounded with panel-level\u8865\u4e01 reasoning.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"If the checklist encodes a causal model (not just surface correlations), the panel's accuracy should remain robust even when surface cues are manipulated to point away from the correct answer, because the panel still applies the deeper structural reasoning the checklist is designed to elicit. If the checklist is merely a surface-correlational heuristic, decoupling surface cues from structure causes the panel to track the manipulated cues and fail, exposing compliance rather than genuine reliability. A single evaluation containing such adversarial items therefore distinguishes the two.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
